description: Phase-37 RESEARCH-ONLY producer/consumer bytes-layout comparand discovery. Read ONLY by scripts/bytes_layout_comparand.py (un-wired). Links a bytes CONSUMER (decode/slice/mload/shift) to its PRODUCER (abi.encode/encodePacked/bytes.concat/mstore/packed-shift) via generic structural evidence (NOT name-only), extracts both field layouts, and reports a concrete layout_mismatch. A bytes_offset_decode_mismatch reaches STRONG only when both layouts are extracted and concretely conflict, with downstream value/authority use. Generic standard-Solidity vocab only — NO subject-specific (e.g. dittoeth) names. is_gate:false research_only:true routes_in_production:false routed_manifest_ids:[].

support_levels.strong_requires: both layouts extracted with concrete fields AND a concrete conflict (field_count / offset / type / width / field_order)
support_levels.medium: one layout concrete, the other partial, with a plausible conflict
support_levels.weak: relationship found but layouts not concretely extractable
